registration: Before the first timed run; no sample removal or adaptive trial count

campaign.scheduler: All six interleavings of two actors with two call steps each; actual shared Aether heap
campaign.resources: Three cases: fill/checksum 4096 materialized bytes, refuse the next byte at declared quota, release and reuse; candidate observes quota result
campaign.network: Three cases: serialize/parse actual JSON frames with duplication, malformed bytes, checksum corruption, drop and delivery; candidate checks integrity and sequence
campaign.eventOrder: Three cases: later event before earlier event, candidate rejects stale sequence
campaign.admission: 100% of declared cases, no precondition exclusions, all explicit coverage obligations, immutable exact executor report
campaign.shrinking: At most 64 attempts per failure; preserve all actor operations, reduce input magnitude/schedule inversions, retain the exact failure property and original witness
campaign.scope: Bounded deterministic cooperative call-boundary scheduling and isolated host resource/network models; not native-thread or distributed hardware campaign qualification

r04BoundaryRate.inputKind: Four-field integer JSON event: order=i%24, sequence=i, allocation=(i*31)%4097, checksum=(i*17)%256
excluded: diagnostics and durable raw observation writes between trials
r04BoundaryRate.passRule: Every one of the five measured trials must reach the unchanged threshold; first trial retained
r04BoundaryRate.qualification: Local fixed R04 JSON boundary kernel only; passing does not qualify full distributed or Aether runtime micro-world throughput
